paper_title: CodeRAG-Bench Can Retrieval Augment Code Generation
caption: Performance with different chunking sizes.

annotations.annotation: The line plot illustrates the performance of different resources as the number of tokens increases. The x-axis is labeled "Number of Tokens" and follows a linear scale ranging from 200 to 1000, with tick marks at intervals of 200 units. The y-axis represents performance, though specific units are not indicated, and it appears linearly scaled and ranges from 10 to 40, with tick marks at intervals of 10 units. There are four lines on the plot: a blue solid line with circular markers represents "Tutorials," beginning at approximately 23 when x = 200 and increasing slightly to around 30 at x = 800, then stabilizing. A red solid line with circular markers indicates "Library Documentation," starting at about 28 when x = 200, peaking at approximately 32 at x = 500, and declining to around 27 at x = 800. The yellow solid line with circular markers denotes "StackOverflow posts", beginning at a height of 32 and decreasing steadily to about 12 by x = 1000. Finally, a green solid line with circular markers represents "Github files," starting at 29 and rising smoothly to around 32 at x = 800, then slightly declining to about 30 at x = 1000. The yellow line and green line intersect at an x value of approximately 500. A legend is available on the top of the plot to infer different lines by their styles.
